I have dandruff.

I tried a number of things over the years, none of which worked, then completely on accident ended up with a solution involving failed solutions.

 

First, I use a small amount of shampoo to lubricate my hair.

Second, I use a fine-toothed comb to scrape the dandruff off my scalp. I double check to make sure there is none left.

Third, I apply enough Head & Shoulders to cover affected areas without lathering. It will tingle the entire time.

Lastly, I sit there for several minutes before rinsing.

 

No promises on whether this works for you regardless of your dandruff status.
